content.hebrew: אַתָּה כּוֹנַֽנְתָּ לְזֶֽרַע אֱמוּנֶֽיךָ צֶֽדֶק וּמֵשָׁרִים,
content.transliteration: Atta konanta lezera‘ emunekha tsedeḳ umesharim,
content.english: You established justice and uprightness for the progeny of Your faithful,
You informed them of commandments and upright statutes.

content.hebrew: רָאמוֹת וְגָבִישׁ לֹא יַעַרְכוּם, וּמִפְּנִינִים יְקָרִים,
content.transliteration: Ramot veḡavish lo ya‘arkhum, umippeninim yeḳarim,
content.english: [The precious stones] ramoth and gavish cannot approximate them; they are more precious than pearls.
content.comments: Ramoth and gavish. Unidentified precious stones.

content.english: They are reliable, and refined like gold in crucibles.
Their secrets, from their treasures, teach lovingkindness to humanity.
When a man buys a slave from among the Hebrews,
[People] who have fallen [on hard times], or been sold [as punishment] for theft,

content.hebrew: שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים בְּיַד אֲדֹנֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ נִמְסָרִים,
content.english: For six years shall they be given into their masters’ hand,
And in the seventh, they shall go out to freedom and liberty.

content.hebrew: וְכִי יְשַׁלְּחוּם, לֹא יֵצְאוּ רֵקִים וּנְעוּרִים,
content.transliteration: Vekhi yeshalleḥum, lo yetse’u reḳim un‘urim,
content.english: And when they send them out, they should not go out empty-handed and destitute,
But rather with the best portions and gifts.
But if they profess love for their masters,

content.hebrew: יִרְצְעוּם בַּמַּרְצֵֽעַ, וְעַד עוֹלָם הֵם נֶעֱצָרִים.
content.english: Then [the masters] should pierce them with an awl, and they will be retained forever.
And [there are] other laws, both light and severe:

content.hebrew: נֶֽפֶשׁ תַּֽחַת נָֽפֶשׁ וּשְׁבָרִים תַּֽחַת שְׁבָרִים,
content.transliteration: Nefesh taḥat nefesh ushvarim taḥat shevarim,
content.english: A life for a life, and damages for damages,
And the laws of oxen, docile and dangerous,

content.hebrew: וּפֹתֵֽחַ בּוֹר וְנָפַל שָֽׁמָּה שׁוֹר אוֹ חֲמֹרִים,
content.transliteration: Ufote’aḥ bor venafal shamma shor o ḥamorim,
content.english: And [of] someone who opens up a pit, into which fall oxen or asses.

content.hebrew: וְגֹנֵב שׁוֹר וּטְבָחוֹ – יְשַׁלֵּם חֲמֵֽשֶׁת בְּקָרִים,
content.transliteration: Veḡonev shor utvaḥo – yeshallem ḥameshet beḳarim,
content.english: And if one steals an ox, and slaughters it, one must pay back five head of cattle,
And four of sheep for sheep that have been sold.
And four [types of] guardians are mentioned,
And, similarly, [four] major categories of torts are listed.

content.hebrew: לֹא יַעֲלֶה בְּפִֽינוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים.
content.transliteration: Lo ya‘alē befinu shem elohim aḥerim.
content.english: The names of other gods may not be mentioned in our mouths.
To Moses, the creator of mountains said
To ascend, and with him some of the Israelites, the pure ones.
And Moses alone came near to the maker of luminaries.

content.hebrew: וּמֵשִׁיב לָעָם דְּבַר יוי, בְּהוֹד וַהֲדָרִים.
content.transliteration: Umeshiv la‘am devar Adonai, behod vahadarim.
content.english: He brought back Adonai’s word to the people, gloriously and beautifully,
And they said: “We will do and we will hear all the words!”

content.hebrew: אֲזַי כָּרֹת כָּרַת עִמָּם בְּרִית, כִּבְרִית הַבְּתָרִים.
content.transliteration: Azai karot karat ‘immam berit, kivrit habbetarim.
content.english: Then He indeed made a covenant with them, like the Covenant Between the Pieces.
And the upright elders of Israel

content.hebrew: חָזוּ כָבוֹד, וְתַֽחַת רַגְלָיו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה לִבְנַת הַסַּפִּירִים.
content.transliteration: Ḥazu khavod, vetaḥat raḡlav kema‘asē livnat hassappirim.
content.english: Saw the Glory, and under His legs was like something made of lapis-lazuli brick.

content.hebrew: אַךְ נֶאֱמַן בַּֽיִת עָלָה בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים,
content.english: But the faithful one of His house ascended to the top of the mountain,
content.comments: The faithful one of His house. Moses.

content.english: To bring down the tablets, which were cut out of the hewing of splendor.
And he was on the mountain for a number of days,
And concealed mysteries were revealed to him.

content.hebrew: מַהְלְכִים לוֹ עִם מַלְאֲכֵי עֹז מִתְאַזְּרִים,
content.english: He made his way among the angels, who are girded in might,
Who constantly declare that Adonai’s name is noble,
Congregation: [As they] call out to one another, saying:

content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Veḳara zē el zē ve’amar
content.english: Cantor. They call out to one another, saying:

content.hebrew: קהל: קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יו֥י צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ: (ישעיהו ו:ג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ḳadosh, Ḳadosh Ḳadosh Adonai tseva’ot melo khol ha’arets kevodo:
content.english: Congregation: Holy, holy, holy is Adonai Ẓeva’oth; the entire world is full of His Glory. (Isa. 6:3)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “Lord of Hosts.”
